title: Conservative Three-Layer Schemes for Kirchhoff-Type Equations
summary: We study a Kirchhoff-type nonlinear integro-differential equation in two spatial dimensions whose coefficients are allowed to depend on time, and we construct conservative discretizations in time for the associated initial--boundary value problem. We consider two symmetric three-layer schemes of Crank--Nicolson type, a locally linear one and a genuinely nonlinear one, and we show that each of them preserves a discrete analogue of the total mechanical energy of the homogeneous problem with constant coefficients.
